# RoamWise

> RoamWise is a free AI travel planner built for Indian travellers. It turns a
> one-line request ("chill 4 days near Rishikesh under 12k") into a complete
> day-by-day itinerary with a real budget breakdown, an interactive map, group
> cost-splitting, and nearby discovery. No signup, no forced subscription.

## What RoamWise does
- AI trip planning via "Ailon Tusk" — plain-language requests to full itineraries
- Day-by-day interactive maps with satellite and terrain views
- Group trip hub — shared chat, fair expense splitting, group decisions
- Near Me — food, sights and things to do around the traveller
- Fitness-first stays, tribe travel, greener-trip suggestions
- Honest budget breakdowns in Indian rupees

## Pricing
- Free to start, no signup needed to plan a trip
- Founder offer: Pro for a one-time Rs 100 (lifetime), limited to the first 1,000 members
- After the founder seats are filled, standard plans apply (daily, weekly, monthly, 3-month, yearly, lifetime); current prices are listed in the app's payment screen

## Stays
- Homestays and hotels in Almora (Milan Heights, Soulmate Homestay, Big Bro Hotel for long workations), booked directly with the host: https://www.roamwise.co.in/stays/almora/
- Almora workation: 15-night to 3-month stays at Big Bro Hotel (Rs 30,000 / 15 nights, Rs 50,000 / month, Rs 1,50,000 / 3 months, meals extra; Wi-Fi speed as told by the owner): https://www.roamwise.co.in/workation/almora/
- Each stay enquiry carries a short RoamWise code (RW-XXXXXX). Stay payments are made to the property directly, not to RoamWise.

## Partners and matching
- Partner chooser on the home page for travel creators, stays, painting artists, music artists, transport providers, colleges and local businesses
- Explainable matching: each suggested stay lists the visible reasons it fits (same town, cafe or lounge space for art or music, direct WhatsApp contact for pickups, and so on). When nothing fits, it says so instead of forcing a match
- Matches are suggestions only. Both sides approve the terms; RoamWise never moves money automatically
- Paid Featured placement on the home page, labelled "Featured": Rs 500 for 7 days, Rs 1,000 for 15 days, Rs 2,000 for 30 days in the first position. Details: https://www.roamwise.co.in/feature/
- Official payment address (also on https://www.roamwise.co.in/pay/): roamwisepay@ybl, account holder MOHIT PANDEY
